scope: Selective review of two new related low-quality Egypt automotive posts after Elantra/MG6 batch 10
method: Manual live rendered-page review of factual gaps and diagnostic usefulness; word count by itself is not a grade; no automated Google score.

findings: The original 280-word text usefully advises not to test SRS circuits with a lamp but lacks explicit distinctions between CN7 Egyptian manual AC and higher-trim dual-zone systems, as specified by Hyundai Egypt.
No safety-prioritized differentiation for airbag clock spring with steering wheel switches, CKP hot-no-start, O2 trims and weak cooling at idle.
No primary Egypt Hyundai manufacturer sources, no representative diagnostic comparison table, no in-article illustration or useful internal links to rebuilt engine and transmission guides.

Intro correctly discourages equating all A7/A8 torsion beam/multilink layouts, but the current 200-word article gives no side-by-side VIN/axle identification, rear suspension wear, toe/camber checks or safety criteria.
Factory Škoda global Octavia suspension press info confirms configuration depends on engine/market; factory Egypt technical and brochure should be cited with explicit no-extrapolation guard.
No practical owner symptom-to-check table, no internal links to recent verified Octavia engine/gearbox/AC articles or original visual.
